## Four Core Competency Pillars

1. **Web Dev Design**: High-performance edge architectures, responsive luxury UI/UX systems, e-commerce store optimizations, and zero-server-cost serverless deployments.
2. **SEO**: Programmatic edge SEO engines, technical audits (GA4/GSC), Schema.org entity knowledge graphs, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO).
3. **Writer**: Executive pitch decks, bankable business feasibility models, peer-reviewed empirical research papers, and editorial storytelling.
4. **Data Analysis**: Applied mathematical modeling, psychometric survey validation (Rasch and Aiken), stealth Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) scraping, and deterministic financial simulations.

## Canonical Architecture Blueprints & Case Studies

### 1. Web Dev Design
- [Master Case Studies Index](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/): Full directory of verified designs and testbeds.
- [3-Tier Proof Methodology](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/methodology/): High-level system design verification before client delivery.
- [Gworky Edge Next.js Flagship](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/web-dev-design/gworky-edge-web-app/): Next.js 15 on Cloudflare Edge with high-concurrency PostgreSQL.
- [WooCommerce Platform Optimization](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/web-dev-design/woocommerce-enhancement-659829/): Non-destructive checkout audit and wp_usermeta index resolution.
- [DevPDF.in Engine & Conversion Architecture](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/web-dev-design/pdf-tools-devpdf-repair-658700/): High-throughput asynchronous PDF conversion pipeline and server-side binary worker stabilization.
- [Interactive Web Audio & Canvas Engine](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/web-dev-design/interactive-birthday-card-web-656043/): Turnkey mobile sensory engine featuring Web Audio synthesis, canvas particle physics, and WebRTC remote control.
- [High-Performance Animated Landing Engine](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/web-dev-design/animated-landing-page-659928/): Sub-25KB zero-dependency agency showcase with 60 FPS GPU-accelerated micro-interactions.
- [Modular Fullstack Web Architecture](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/web-dev-design/fullstack-custom-web-apps-659861/): Clean relational data modeling, stateless JWT authentication, and idempotent REST endpoints.
- [Elementor JSON UI Architecture Engine](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/web-dev-design/elementor-json-ui-engine/): Lean component export-import pipelines without plugin bloat.

### 2. SEO
- [Programmatic SEO Edge Scale Engine](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/seo/programmatic-seo-scale-engine/): R2 payloads serving 50+ city and university hubs at global edge latency.
- [Technical SEO & GA4/GSC Audit](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/seo/technical-seo-vidio-tirto-audit/): Organic search architecture dissection on national media portals (Vidio.com and Tirto.id).
- [National SEO Competition Award (WOM Finance)](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/seo/national-seo-competition-wom-finance/): Documentation of 3rd place national award-winning long-form editorial ranking.
- [Entity Knowledge Graph Architecture](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/seo/knowledge-graph-entity-architecture/): Tri-node Wikidata, ORCID, and Google Scholar entity mesh.

### 4. Data Analysis
- [Automated Jira Weekly Performance Reporting Pipeline](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/data-analysis/jira-weekly-report-automation-40725359/): Serverless data engineering pipeline aggregating Jira Cloud sprint burndown velocity and developer worklogs into an executive A4 PDF.
- [Enterprise Power BI & Power Query ETL](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/data-analysis/power-bi-power-query-etl-650821/): Star-schema dimensional modeling, M-code query folding preservation, and automated DAX measures.
- [Mathematical Modeling & Statistics](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/data-analysis/mathematical-modeling-and-statistics/): 140 SKS mathematical rigor, classical assumption validation, and deterministic computing.
- [DocuMorph PDF Table Extraction](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/data-analysis/documorph-pdf-table-extraction/): Lossless tabular extraction pipeline from complex PDF artifacts.
- [Morpheus V2 Financial Simulation Model](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/data-analysis/morpheus-v2-tax-simulation-659758/): High-precision statutory tax simulation utilizing the Python Decimal module.
- [Psychometric Survey Validation](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/data-analysis/psychometric-survey-validation-rasch/): Rasch model logit transformations and Aiken's V validity coefficients.
- [Resilient CDP WebSocket Scraping](https://zadevpenseo.github.io/case-studies/data-analysis/resilient-cdp-websocket-scraping/): Stealth Chrome DevTools Protocol harvesting under active Cloudflare Turnstile.
